name: Soran'ruk Fragment
summary: In Blackfathom Deeps, cultists hold shards of Soran'ruk, a shattered prison orb. The pieces still carry fel energy from the demon once bound inside.

sections.title: A Shattered Prison
sections.body: Soran'ruk's prison orb was broken apart after the demon fell from favor with the Burning Legion. Demons who displease their masters may have their spirits sealed in orbs, then given to fel spellcasters as sources of power. The Twilight's Hammer cultists in the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps possess smaller shards from one half of the orb. They draw on the lingering demonic essence for their own workings.

sections.title: Reconstruction in the Barrens
sections.body: Each fragment still holds a trace of the imprisoned demon's vitality. Doan Karhan, a reclusive scholar in the southern Barrens, has spent a lifetime studying demonic vessels and owns a similar orb, the Orb of Zargain. An ambitious warlock can bring him three small fragments and the larger piece held in Silverpine. He can forge the relic whole again as an instrument of power.

faq.answer: Soran'ruk was a demon of the Burning Legion who fell from favor with its leaders. As punishment, its spirit was drawn out and trapped in a crystalline orb, where it served mortal warlocks and mages as a source of energy.
Twilight Acolytes carry the smaller shards through the cavernous halls of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: Why does the Twilight's Hammer have these shards?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cultists gather the shards because they retain the trapped demon's magical essence. They use corrupt artifacts to fuel their dark rituals and channel forbidden magic.

faq.q: Who can restore the Orb of Soran'ruk?
aliases: where to turn in soranruk fragment
faq.answer: Doan Karhan can restore the Orb of Soran'ruk. The solitary hermit lives in the southern Barrens near the border of Thousand Needles and studies and reforges the Burning Legion's demonic orbs.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can use demonic prison vessels like the Orb of Soran'ruk to channel raw fel energy without directly subjugating a demon.
